svg.title: Hirose HR10A-10P-12P(73), male plug, mating face
svg.desc: Orthographic front view, main key at 12 o'clock. Twelve silver contacts in black polyamide, with a matte nickel shell. Pin 1 is upper left; pin 9 upper right. Independently authored UI illustration referencing Hirose mechanical drawing EDC-010386-73-73 and HR10 catalog. Surface finish, knurl microgeometry and pin tip profiles are illustrative. Not a manufacturing drawing.
svg.metadata: Units: 64 SVG units per mm. Maximum shell diameter: 14.7 mm. Transparent background. Projection: mating side. Contact IDs: pin-1 through pin-12. Sources and accuracy limits: README.md and geometry.json.
